answer.text: Mandatory option offered to investors — no distributor

explanation.text: The Logic: SEBI mandates PMs to OFFER direct on-boarding (no distribution fee channel) as an investor choice. The Trap: It's not prohibited; it's required. Cross-Exam Context: XXI-A Topic 9. Manager's Pro-Tip: Direct clients save 50-100 bps/year — highlight this in marketing as cost-conscious pitch.
